propositions: CLI timeout flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) permanently shadow ini budget changes carried in patchsets due to pytest-timeout precedence CLI > ini and trusted-main workflow execution
Patchset-carried ini timeout budget changes cannot be exercised by their own Verified run when CLI flags are present, preventing self-verification of timeout config updates
The shared-tier lanes should be flag-free to enable single-sourcing the 300s thread-method budget from pyproject.toml ini options, allowing patchsets that modify the budget to test themselves

Effective timeout budget (300s, thread method) remains unchanged; only the authority moves from CLI flags to ini config so future budget modifications travel with the patchset and are tested by their own gate run
The conftest-floor hardening approach is rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout at session start read-only with no supported hook point
All other pytest lanes outside _build-and-test.yml (external-integration, optionality, eval-discipline, test.yml, structured-output-baseline) must retain their explicit calibrated CLI timeout flags
